name: negative-seal-count-loads
note: Three seals for session s1, all signed by the key and naming its keyId. In line order they count -1 (sealedAt 2026-07-31T00:00:02Z), -2 (00:00:01Z) and 1 (00:00:03Z). §3 makes finalCount an integer (§1.1) and nothing more, and §4 step 2 loads a seal on its keyId and signature, the first loadable seal for a session winning: first in the registry, which §3 makes an append-only file of one seal per line, and whose sealedAt it gives no form to order by. So the seal counting -1 LOADS and wins, and the one receipt present exceeds it: count-exceeds-seal against -1. A verifier that drops a seal for counting below zero, or lets the last seal, the largest count or the latest sealedAt win, grades this store ok; one that lets the smallest count or the earliest sealedAt win compares the receipt with -2.
